title: Record list response
description: The answer to GET <base>/records/<entityType>: the rows, and a meta block. Hand-written; see data-protocol.md.

total.description: The number of records matching the request (after filter, before offset and limit), not the number of rows in this answer. The runtime computes "there is more" as total > offset + data.length. See data-protocol.md §5.2.

scope.description: project, or owner for a per-visitor collection.
